voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.32 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: FWD: Si Maria Labo, nakabalik na raw. Ingat kayo.
lines.beat_before: hook: the phone in a hand in the dark: 1 message received; it opens: FWD

lines.text: Noong dekada nobenta, kumalat ito sa text. Isang babaeng naging aswang daw, at tinaga ng asawa ang mukha niya.
lines.beat_before: the town at night from above: in window after window, a phone screen lights green

lines.text: Nasa Iloilo raw siya. Hindi, sa Capiz. Hindi, nandito na raw.
lines.beat_before: the phone: forwards pile up, each FWD longer, each place different

lines.text: Manikurista raw siya sa palengke. Laging nakatakip ang buhok sa kalahati ng mukha.
lines.beat_before: the market by day: a manicure stall, a woman with her hair over half her face

lines.text: Walang biktimang naitala. Walang petsa. Tsismis lang na pinapasa-pasa.
lines.beat_before: the phone: the thread scrolls, FWD: FWD: FWD:, the inbox count climbing

lines.text: Pero gabi-gabi, may nanay na nagsasara ng pinto.
lines.beat_before: night: a mother hurries her children inside and bars the door

lines.text: Isang text mula sa hindi kilalang numero.
lines.beat_before: the phone on the table vibrates: an unknown number
the message: Diin kamo? Ara ko sa gwa. The phone light lifts to the jalousie
